edits.before: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and shield win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.
edits.after: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and range win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: His Baleful Strike outranges your harass and stacks free AP — Q-farm at max range, give nothing away.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online and his cage doesn't exist yet — step up and trade Q-W-Q; level 2 is your window, not his.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA spike: sustained Q-E DPS plus the root beats his single-target burst before his AP stacks mature — force trades.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and a clean W root shuts off his one-shot setup: EQ deletes him, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Veigar E Event Horizon: 20s at rank 1, 14s max — only the cage EDGE stuns; hold near the center or leave before it forms. That 20s downtime is your all-in window. - His R runs 120/90/60s. - Your W Rune Prison (11s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Cycle Q to keep the passive shield loaded
edits.after: Cycle Q to keep Overload runes charged

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: E-Q resets keep runes charged — the two-rune speed burst sidesteps Dark Matter and walks you out of the cage's edge.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: Below half HP his R executes off missing health — a cage clip into Dark Matter plus R is a kill you handed over free.

edits.before: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and shield win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.
edits.after: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and range win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP is the map-game backbone. Nothing else is defensible on you.
